Good entry points for orienting yourself in a subarea before reading individual papers.

**20 entries**, newest first within each section. Add papers by editing `data/surveys.yaml` (see [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).

## End-to-End & General

- **End-to-end Autonomous Driving: Challenges and Frontiers**: Most-cited E2E survey: [Link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.16927) - [Code](https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/End-to-end-Autonomous-Driving) · *TPAMI 2024*
